summary: Strawberry Fields REIT filed an 8-K announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.17 per share declared by its Board on August 6, 2026. The dividend is payable September 30, 2026 to stockholders of record as of September 16, 2026. No special situation such as a tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review is involved; it is an ordinary dividend declaration. The filing includes a press release describing the company's portfolio of skilled nursing and healthcare properties. This is a routine event with no structural or deal-related implications, and thus does not qualify as a special situation.
